title: Add steward-written brief fields to proposals and render them first
summary: The steward, when it raises a proposal above its limit, writes five plain-language fields (question, if_yes, if_no, cost, recommendation with a one-line reason) into the work-item record. The decisions page (xtask/src/decisions.rs) renders them before any evidence path, puts paths in a collapsed section, and shows the title with 'No brief written yet' when absent. No text-rewriting code is added. Audience: the owner who decides proposals.

defaults_applied.how: Tests for both render cases, record round-trip and the prompt; cargo test and clippy pass.
Criteria check rendered output order and the exact fallback text.
The model writes the plain-language fields, not string rules.
Page text and prompt are written for the owner as an outside reader.
One optional field and one render change.
The verifier runs the named cargo tests.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: I read crates/athena-data/src/records.rs: WorkItem (deny_unknown_fields, validate()) gains one optional `brief` field (serde default, skip if none) holding the five fields, so existing records still parse. The records validation is check_record_file (records.rs:3003), which parses bytes into AnyRecord::WorkItem and then runs WorkItem::validate; the new field is accepted there, and the existing round-trip test using sample_work_item (records.rs ~3737) is extended to cover a work item with a brief and one without. I also read crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs: decide() builds the WorkItem from a ProposedChange and returns Decision::Proposed above the role's limit, so the brief is carried from ProposedChange into the item only on that path. Every other WorkItem constructor (steward.rs, audience.rs:98, work_decisions.rs and drain.rs tests) must set brief None.

Code survey: the entry point for rendering is xtask/src/decisions.rs: Brief::new from a WorkItem, Brief::html, render, and the existing check that a brief has a recommendation line and is under MAX_WORDS. The new fields are rendered directly from the record, as stored text escaped with the existing escape; the existing derived recommendation() string is replaced for items with a brief. Evidence paths move into an HTML details element. The existing word-limit check must not reject a record without a brief.

Code survey: the steward prompt is STEWARD_PROMPT in crates/athena-data/src/roles.rs:120; the prompt budget in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs (steward_system_prompt) must still fit, so the added text stays short. How the steward model's output reaches ProposedChange (its output parser in steward.rs) must be extended to read the five fields.
The user's stated rule 'no text transformation code in the site build' is read as: no title-to-question rewriting; escaping and layout only.
Governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) are not changed; the pages workflow already renders this page.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test builds a steward proposal WorkItem with all five fields and asserts the rendered page contains question, if_yes, if_no, cost and recommendation text, each at an earlier byte offset than the first evidence path, and that the paths sit inside a collapsed <details> element.
Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test renders a proposal WorkItem with no brief and asserts the output contains its title and the exact text 'No brief written yet', and that rendering does not fail.

STEWARD_PROMPT in crates/athena-data/src/roles.rs names the five fields (question, if_yes, if_no, cost, recommendation with a one-line reason) and the owner-style rules (short, plain, no jargon); a unit test in crates/athena-data asserts these terms are present (checkable with Grep).
Run `cargo test -p athena-data`: the records round-trip and check_record_file tests accept a work item with a brief and one without (old records still parse), and reject a brief with an empty field.
Run `cargo test -p athena-core`: a steward test shows decide() on a rung above the role's limit yields a WorkItem carrying the brief, and that the steward output parser reads the five fields.
Grep of xtask/src/decisions.rs shows no new code that rewrites, splits or replaces words in titles; the page code only escapes and lays out stored fields.
Run `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`: all pass, including the existing decisions-page tests and the prompt budget tests.

out_of_scope: Any code that rewrites proposal titles into questions
departures: Touches the record type, steward, prompt and site code across four crates, so cost and time lean above the reference.
